about.title: About TerraNep
about.description: TerraNep is a free, mobile-first, high-definition 3D terrain map of Nepal combining real satellite imagery, AWS Terrarium elevation models, and real-time live environmental data.
about.attribution_aws: Terrain DEM: AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles (Terrarium encoding)

about.attribution_usgs: Earthquakes: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program API
about.attribution_meteo: Weather & Air Quality: Open-Meteo Public API
about.attribution_districts: Districts: Nepal Survey Dept / geoBoundaries (Open Data)
